cba.banner_text: Every 2027 figure is a 2022 CBA carry-forward: the agreement expires 2026-12-01 and no threshold, league minimum, arbitration structure or qualifying-offer value past it has been published. Where Spotrac uses a different 2027 basis the page prints both, each labelled.

copy.masthead: Every dollar a club has on the books, from Spotrac and the platform's own models, with what each dollar is projected to buy. No revenue, no valuations, no TV money: nothing here says what a club earns.
copy.league_lede: Thirty clubs on two Spotrac bases and the platform's own prices. Only Cost+ and OrgSur+ take a colour; every dollar cell prints plain, and the league average row is a reference, never a club.
copy.footer_means_note: The two rows differ by $17.0M because Spotrac's league average is the page's average row as fetched 2026-07-07, while the 30 club rows were refetched 2026-09-24; the basis is the same (Spotrac total payroll allocations 2027), so the gap is 2027 money that reached club books between the two fetches.
copy.club_foot: Descriptive ledger. No single projected payroll is served: contract dollars on file, projected arbitration steps and rule minimums are three keys the page never sums.
copy.cba_banner: Every 2027 figure is a 2022 CBA carry-forward: the agreement expires 2026-12-01 and no threshold, league minimum, arbitration structure or qualifying-offer value past it has been published. Where Spotrac uses a different 2027 basis the page prints both, each labelled.
copy.cbt_computed_label: computed from Spotrac tax payroll and the 2022 CBA schedule (cba_rules.json)
copy.cbt_clock_rule: the rate resets to first-time after one full season under the threshold; rule text, not a forecast
copy.cbt_verify_note: every cba_rules record is curated-unverified; the 2027 threshold is explicitly unknown
copy.qo_recipient_note: which clubs receive revenue sharing is not sourceable here; that QO pick tax tier is a league value only
copy.split_2026_note: the 2026 Spotrac payroll page carries no active / injured / retained / buried split; the strip is drawn for 2027 only
copy.allocations_note: CBT payroll is Spotrac's AAV basis; total payroll allocations are Spotrac's cash basis
copy.history_blocked_on: Payroll history is cached but not yet ingested (fa_team_payroll holds 2026-2027); the cache-only backfill of the 2016-2025 Spotrac pages has not run

commitments_bases.contract: Contract dollars on file (Spotrac, never re-priced)
commitments_bases.prearb: Pre-arb minimums by rule (780,000 per PRE-ARB season, salary_path.LEAGUE_MIN_CURATED[2026] carried forward)

copy.commitments_not_summed: three labelled segments and a count of unpriced vets; no key sums them into a payroll, because that sum would be a forecast without a registry row
copy.horizon_label: half of today's contract dollars roll off by
copy.expiring_basis: fa_class members from this club; projected guarantees are sums of means and the P10-P90 band is shown per player in the free agency block
holes: every 2027+ arbitration step is a 2022 CBA carry-forward past the 2026-12-01 expiry, and no interval covers that
the class token is inferred rather than read from published service time on most board rows, and class closure uses it twice, once for the rung and once for the horizon
arb-2+ is a served null (an empirical step multiplier beat the model), and closure runs that same multiplier one to two rungs further
window length is a property of Spotrac's grid depth, so two comparable players can carry two and four priced seasons for no baseball reason
copy.options_note: Options on file (curated: salPath option stamps, contract_options.json and the trade board's Spotrac years); Spotrac years_remaining omits them.
copy.deferral_rate_label: NPV at the platform 7 pct rate
copy.deferral_coverage: covered deals only: every guarantee of 200M or more has an entry (audited into fa_gate2_eval.deferral_coverage); this is not a complete club deferral ledger
copy.deferral_rate_note: the platform discounts at 7 pct, which differs from the CBT statutory rate, so these NPVs read lower than league-reported figures
copy.dead_money_blocked_on: Spotrac's dataTable-dead rows carry no table_id on the read side yet (spotrac._parse_team_contract_table); the tag trails v1 so the priced contract set cannot widen by accident
copy.dead_money_beside: Spotrac 2027 buried allocation, a different table with an overlapping definition; never summed with dead money
copy.retained_blocked_on: Spotrac's dataTable-retained rows carry no table_id on the read side yet; retained obligations are never merged into the employing club's AAV
copy.arb_upper_bound: Upper bound, not a payroll forecast: non-tenders and extensions are absent
copy.arb_provisional: provisional: the arb-1 model is gated, arb-2+ is a population multiplier
copy.arb_flag_key: flag bits: 1 step not from published service time, 2 step from the debut heuristic, 4 no salary on file, 8 past the CBA expiry, 16 2020 prorated
copy.arb_realized_title: What arbitration cost, and what it bought
copy.arb_realized_copy: Realized value, not skill: what arbitration paid and what the seasons returned. The counterfactual, what the club would have paid had it settled or gone to a hearing differently, is not observed.
copy.ou_mkt: actual minus OUR model: what the arbitration system paid relative to comparable players. Sums to roughly zero by construction.
copy.ou_war: actual minus WAR (eWAR basis) priced at that season's dollars per win. Does NOT sum to zero, because arbitration systematically pays below the open market.
copy.never_combine: The two residuals answer different questions and are never averaged or summed. No combined column exists and none may be added.
copy.surplus_basis: MLB leg: MLB Projections surNpv at dpw 17,971,003 (2027 ex-ante), 5-season horizon, 7 pct discount, usd converted to $M; farm leg: org_summary active surplus ($M, prospect_surplus validated). Both legs in $M before the sum.
copy.surplus_no_tier: a club total sits above the player-row surplus ladder's top cut nearly everywhere, so it prints plain
copy.surplus_ev: Sur+ sums are sums of expected values; quantiles are never summed
copy.trade_currency_basis: Trade Machine currency (trade_machine_surplus provisional); overlaps the MLB and farm legs by construction and is never added to them
copy.trajectory_note: since late June, no earlier history
copy.cost_plus_basis: descriptive index: a ratio of two served numbers, not a model
copy.cost_plus_registry: no registry row: Cost+ predicts nothing; a skill claim would need an eval first

fin_contract_surplus.basis: usd per year: current AAV minus bonus amortized over six years, graduates

fin_draft_pool_efficiency.basis: WAR per $M of draft pool in window

fin_ifa_roi.basis: WAR per $M of IFA bonus, eight-season window

copy.farm_letters_note: letters come from org_summary.grades (rank across 30 orgs) and are never recomputed; a sparse leaf prints a dash
copy.pools_note: 2021 holds nine clubs (parser miss on the MLB.com article); 2027 pools are not published
copy.slot_coverage_basis: share of the league's draft_results rows for that year carrying slot_usd
copy.pool_used_basis: bonuses on the round 1-10 slotted picks over the published pool, which is the sum of those slot values; the Paid column also counts rounds 11 and later, which carry no slot, and their bonuses above $150,000 are not added to Pool used
copy.pick_war_label: expected first-6 WAR of the 2027 first-round pick (draft_slot_curve, validated; on the projected slot, not lottery-weighted)
copy.pick_war_why: the lottery snapshot carries the odds of pick 1 and of a top-6 pick, not the full odds vector, so the expectation is on the projected slot
copy.pick_dollars: pick dollars are not served: the only in-repo pick pricing is the QO tax method
copy.ifa_implied_basis: implied from Spotrac pool percentages, not a published allocation
copy.ifa_history_blocked_on: IFA classes 2009-2018 are cached but run_monthly caps the range at 2021; extending it is a cache-only ingest deferred past v1, and 2019-2020 pages are not on disk
copy.fits_note: fa_team_fit is provisional: gate-3 MRR .165 against random .133
copy.implied_dpw_note: the club's implied dollars per WAR is not on the archive rows (projected WAR at signing is not stored), so only the league rate prints
copy.realized_title: Contract value delivered (realized, elapsed seasons only)
copy.realized_sentence: This is what the contracts returned, not how well the club chose them. The counterfactual, what the same dollars would have bought elsewhere that winter, is not observed, so no club is ranked by it.
copy.realized_coverage: covered signings carry the realized block; the current winter carries none because no season has elapsed
copy.realized_not_skill: Realized value, not skill: what happened after the money was spent, with the counterfactual unobserved.
copy.no_payroll_line: A single projected payroll is not served: it would need registry row club_payroll_path and the 2016-2025 payroll history as labels.
copy.load_error: The Club Ledger could not be loaded.
copy.arb_dpw_basis: arbitration dollars per WAR 2026 (arbitration.json dpw) over the open-market rate for winter 2026 (fa_dpw_series)
copy.projections_dpw_basis: mlb_projections dpw_usd, 2027 ex-ante, the surplus pricing rate
copy.league_minimum_note: salary_path.LEAGUE_MIN_CURATED; seasons past 2026 carry the last value forward by rule
copy.farm_dollar_is_template: A farm dollar here is an expected value: the eFV expected surplus of an active prospect, in millions, on the clemens_2026 valuation set over its own seven-season window, priced through the platform's calibrated engine (calibration {calibration_version}, prospect_surplus validated on data/surplus_backtest_real.json). It is the mean of a distribution whose 10th and 90th percentiles print on the row. Net of the signing bonus it is what the club roll-up sums.
copy.farm_dollar_is_not: It is not a trade price (the Trade Machine re-anchors debuted players and adds a roster crunch), not the club-control-window surplus the MLB Projections board prices for the prospects it carries (a different window and a different discount), not a quantile, and not a realized figure: no farm dollar has been earned. Quantiles on these rows are never summed, and a row's number is never added to a number on another basis.
copy.farm_reconcile: The roll-up leaf is the sum over active prospects of eFV expected surplus minus the signing bonus on file, computed inside the PROSPX org summary. The rows below carry the same two quantities from the trade board export and the PROSPX prospect rows; their sum is printed beside the leaf with both artifacts' stamps.
copy.farm_vintage_gap: The leaf and the rows were written at different points of the same nightly, and eFV surplus moves nightly; a gap inside the tolerance is vintage drift, not a disagreement about any prospect.
copy.farm_gap_broken: The rows do not reconcile to the leaf beyond the tolerance. Both figures are shown; neither is corrected.
copy.farm_no_bonus: A prospect with no bonus on file counts a cost of zero in the leaf and in these rows; the count is printed beside every cost figure. Most such rows are international signings whose bonus the pipeline never captured.
copy.trade_cost_dark: What a trade cost is the value given up, in FV and surplus, not dollars; no cost basis exists for the trade channel and none is invented. The Trade Machine prices the exchange.
copy.grad_two_engines: Two engines price a graduate: debuted_player_value (PROSPX debuted rows) and the trade board's posterior. Each prints under its own name; they are never averaged or summed.
copy.grad_contract_dark: Grad-Contract Surplus is served as the org mean only (current AAV minus the bonus amortized over six years, storage.py); no per-graduate row is exported, and recomputing one here would be a new number with no registry row.
copy.grad_contract_formula: per graduate with both a current AAV and a bonus on file: AAV minus bonus over six; the org mean and its n are the leaf, which is why n is smaller than the graduate count
copy.grad_no_registry: debuted_player_value carries no registry row of its own; its parent prospect_surplus is validated. Read the debuted column as a served number without its own eval.
copy.shard_failed: The per-club rows did not load; the preview above is the board's.
copy.shard_vintage: These rows were written against a different board build than the one on screen.
copy.dvm_within_tier: $DvM+ is scaled within the prospect's FV tier and clamped 40-160: not on the league z pool, unvalidated.
copy.p_bust_basis: P(bust) on the eFV row is the retired realized_implied map (ground-truthed there); the MLB Projections prospect row's pBust is a different curve and prints only under its own label.
copy.preview_note: top rows by expected surplus; the full farm ledger loads per club
copy.grad_preview_note: the graduate rows load per club
copy.arb_preview_note: the class-year rung per row; the full ladder and the realized rows load per club
copy.trade_preview_note: the debuted trade rows load per club
copy.paths_preview_note: the WAR and surplus strips load per club
copy.trajectory_active_basis: the actives of each snapshot, on that snapshot's own status, gross of bonuses; so it does not chart the leaf and a graduation moves it
copy.band_row_only: p10 to p90, eFV basis, per row only
copy.years_to_fa_dark: control not started; service time is a proxy on this site
copy.service_time_source: PROXY - the pipeline carries no service time. MLB appearance seasons on file (mlb_player_detail career block) upper-bound it; debuts.json roster_status.service_phase overrides where present.
copy.ifa_slot_dark: no slot: IFA is pool-percentage, see implied pool
copy.arb_prearb_rungs: board rows at the pre-arbitration minimum sit in this sum; the arbitration rungs alone are the first figure
copy.arb_two_populations: The stack above prices the club's priced veterans' salary paths; this bar sums the Arbitration Predictor's board rows for the same season. They overlap on the players both carry and differ on the rest; neither is added to the other and neither is a payroll.
copy.swartz_label_template: MLB Trade Rumors, Matt Swartz, published before settlement; present on {n_swartz} history rows, of which the a6 arm scored {n_a6} on identical rows
copy.swartz_a6: This model does not beat the MLB Trade Rumors / Matt Swartz projection. Measured on identical rows, Swartz is materially more accurate at every arbitration step. Reported as a NULL. The mechanism is not mysterious: Swartz prices the counting stats arbitration panels actually reward - home runs, RBI, saves, wins - and this champion deliberately excludes them because nothing in this pipeline projects them forward, which is what lets the same model serve a backtest and a forecast. Swartz is the better estimate of a KNOWN season; it is not available for an unplayed one.
copy.arb_quantiles_dark: P10 / P50 / P90 are not published: the band is the champion's MdAPE spread by rung (arb_export.py) and no per-rung residual quantiles exist
copy.arb_comps_dark: no comps are served; the champion is a ridge level model on log deflated salary (arb-1) and an empirical raise multiplier (arb-2+); a comps consumer must not read the contract set's aav_usd as a player's income (ARBITRATION_GATE 10)
copy.arb_filing_dark: filing figures and hearing outcomes are on no served row; svy is the service-time as-of season
copy.npv_identity: the served NPV discounts the unrounded per-season figures; the strip is rounded to 0.1M, so the two can differ by a few tens of thousands
copy.sur_total_identity: the rest-of-season leg is published to 0.1M and the total was built from the raw float; the printed equation can miss by a few tens of thousands
copy.sur_strip_basis: MLB Projections per-season surplus: convex tier pricing at the 2027 ex-ante FA $/WAR level, escalated per season, minus the season's salary path cell; not war x $/WAR
copy.tv_reanchored: re-anchored on the trade board (archetype posterior floor); the projections figure is the contract row's
copy.prearb_min_floor: remaining pre-arb seasons plus the balance of the season in progress. This basis serves only the rows that carry no salary path at all: a row with one is priced over its whole club control window instead (salary_path, 2026-09-16). Where this basis does serve a row, the arbitration years the club also controls are NOT priced, so a prearb_min value is a FLOOR on the row's true club control window surplus.
copy.opt_out_two_engines: player option seasons: the salary path prices them as guaranteed (opt-out not modelled, salary_path); the trade board's value folds an opt-out probability into this row (bayes_trade_value); the two are different numbers on purpose and neither is a served opt-out value
copy.trade_currency_split: the trade currency is the farm ledger's gross rows plus the debuted rows; it overlaps both legs and is never added to them
copy.shown_rows: shown rows: a sum of expected values
copy.sources_stamps: each block names the artifact and the build stamp it was read from
copy.registry_sentence: provisional rows are labelled with the registry verdict quoted on the Method tab; nothing on this page is scored by this page
copy.farm_dollar_is: A farm dollar here is an expected value: the eFV expected surplus of an active prospect, in millions, on the clemens_2026 valuation set over its own seven-season window, priced through the platform's calibrated engine (calibration isotonic-real-v6-evframe-2026-07-31, prospect_surplus validated on data/surplus_backtest_real.json). It is the mean of a distribution whose 10th and 90th percentiles print on the row. Net of the signing bonus it is what the club roll-up sums.
copy.swartz_label: MLB Trade Rumors, Matt Swartz, published before settlement; present on 282 history rows, of which the a6 arm scored 261 on identical rows

arbitration_eval.claim: our SERVED estimator against the PUBLISHED pre-settlement Swartz projection, on settled figures, identical rows
arbitration_eval.statement: This model does not beat the MLB Trade Rumors / Matt Swartz projection. Measured on identical rows, Swartz is materially more accurate at every arbitration step. Reported as a NULL. The mechanism is not mysterious: Swartz prices the counting stats arbitration panels actually reward - home runs, RBI, saves, wins - and this champion deliberately excludes them because nothing in this pipeline projects them forward, which is what lets the same model serve a backtest and a forecast. Swartz is the better estimate of a KNOWN season; it is not available for an unplayed one.

grad_contract_per_graduate.blocked_on: Grad-Contract Surplus is served as the org mean only (current AAV minus the bonus amortized over six years, storage.py); no per-graduate row is exported, and recomputing one here would be a new number with no registry row.

farm_years_to_fa.blocked_on: control not started; service time is a proxy on this site (trade_values prearb_basis.service_time_source)

farm_bonus_missing.note: partial: actives with no bonus on file are counted per club and per method
farm_bonus_missing.blocked_on: A prospect with no bonus on file counts a cost of zero in the leaf and in these rows; the count is printed beside every cost figure. Most such rows are international signings whose bonus the pipeline never captured.

ifa_slot.blocked_on: no slot: IFA is pool-percentage, see implied pool

arb_quantiles.blocked_on: P10 / P50 / P90 are not published: the band is the champion's MdAPE spread by rung (arb_export.py) and no per-rung residual quantiles exist

arb_comps.blocked_on: no comps are served; the champion is a ridge level model on log deflated salary (arb-1) and an empirical raise multiplier (arb-2+); a comps consumer must not read the contract set's aav_usd as a player's income (ARBITRATION_GATE 10)

arb_filing.blocked_on: filing figures and hearing outcomes are on no served row; svy is the service-time as-of season

arb_service_time.blocked_on: published service time is on a minority of rows; the class token is inferred (flag bit 1)

opt_out_value.blocked_on: player option seasons: the salary path prices them as guaranteed (opt-out not modelled, salary_path); the trade board's value folds an opt-out probability into this row (bayes_trade_value); the two are different numbers on purpose and neither is a served opt-out value

single_payroll_line.blocked_on: needs registry row club_payroll_path and the 2016-2025 payroll history as labels for a backtest

what_this_page_does_not_claim: revenue: no source in the tree carries club revenue or operating income
franchise valuation: no source carries a valuation
attendance money: one season of home-game attendance exists in the game feeds and no history; no gate receipts
ticket prices: not sourced
local or national TV / RSN money: not sourced
central-fund distributions: not sourced
revenue-sharing payer or recipient status: which clubs receive revenue sharing is not sourceable; the QO tax tier for recipients prints as a league value only
minor-league payroll: not sourced
front-office and coaching salaries: not sourced
stadium debt: not sourced
actual CBT bills paid: only Spotrac's estimate for payors and the schedule computed here
2027+ bonus pools and IFA pool allocations as published: pools past 2026 are not on disk and IFA pools are implied from Spotrac percentages
service-time ground truth: the class token is inferred on most arbitration rows
a single projected payroll: three labelled segments only
a prospect or contract number recomputed through value_framework: every figure on the row layers is a copy of a served artifact (PROSPECT_ANCHOR_GATE 13.2)
a summed quantile or a combined residual: bands print per row, footers under a band column read not summed, ou_mkt and ou_war stay apart and the Swartz figure is a third quantity
a dollar cost basis for the trade channel: FV given up is the Trade Machine's currency
a per-graduate Grad-Contract Surplus: the org mean only is served (storage.py)
arbitration comps, filing figures, hearing outcomes or per-rung residual quantiles: none is on any served row
a served opt-out value: player option seasons are priced as guaranteed by the salary path and folded as a probability by the trade board, and neither is an opt-out value
a rank or grade of clubs by farm finance beyond the v1 fin_* leaves
a betting or management figure: the ledger's only touches are two links
